notes.title: The Efficiency Update!
notes.content:
Cirrus Business now features a tighter gameplay loop, improved dialogue, quicker transitions and a whole bunch of other significant improvements!

notes.title: Cirrus Business Release Day!
notes.content:
Before purchasing the full game, we highly encourage you to try the free demo to ensure that you like it. (It contains the first 45 minutes of the game.) Hope you enjoy our passion project! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44198351/19db588772107131378b33f6c0e385e41eacdbe3.png[/img]

notes.title: Cirrus Business Launches on April 11th
notes.content:
Oofin Sprouts is proud to announce, Cirrus Business will available to purchase on Steam on April 11th 2024.  I hope everyone enjoys playing it as much as I enjoyed creating it <3

Much Love,
Oofin Sprouts
